response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced staff/senior engineer with 15+ years across web, embedded, and systems programming, but this is a significant overqualification and seniority mismatch for a junior/mid-level entry role. His deep TypeScript/Node.js and React-adjacent experience covers the required stack, but the role's framing (progressive responsibility, entry-level growth path) and likely compensation band are misaligned with his staff-level trajectory, and there's no PostgreSQL, Nest.js, or renewable energy/CRM integration experience evident.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience including TypeScript, Node.js, and React-adjacent frameworks (Ember.js)
Strong software craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, clean architecture) matching the 'interest in clean architecture' requirement
Proven ability to learn quickly and work across many languages/domains (D, Swift, Java, C++, etc.)
concerns: Vastly overqualified — staff/senior level candidate for a junior/mid-level entry role, likely misaligned on career goals and salary
No direct experience with PostgreSQL (has MySQL, MongoDB) or Nest.js specifically
No evident background in renewable energy, construction tech, or CRM/document management integrations
